title: Unbilled Work Review Queue
businessOutcomes: Finished work is reviewed for billing before it sits uninvoiced.
summary: Turn a job or time-entry export into a skip-ruled unbilled queue. You create or hold each invoice. Nothing is sent or collected.
businessProblem: Completed jobs stay unbilled because the export is hard to review. Staff have to find missing invoices by hand before money can be billed.
outcome: A ranked queue of unbilled work, with skip rules applied, that a person reviews before creating an invoice.
expectedOutcomes: A ranked queue of unbilled work, with skip rules applied, that a person reviews before creating an invoice.
whoItsFor: Service businesses that finish work before they invoice and review a job or time-entry export before billing.
aiInputs: Billing log of work already invoiced
Owner skip rules, such as minimum amount and missing fields
aiOutputs: Field-limited invoice outline for each ready row
Rows held back until missing fields are completed
noCodeTools: Export the job or time sheet, then review the queue in ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini
QuickBooks or Xero report plus a spreadsheet of work already invoiced
lowCodeTools: Spreadsheet export reviewed against the owner's skip rules
Accounting report joined to the billing log before any invoice is created
customBuildStack: Skip rules applied before any outline is drafted
Invoice outlines limited to fields present in the export
No invoice is created, sent, or collected by the template
implementationSteps: Export jobs or time entries and the billing log
Write the skip rules, including the minimum amount and required fields
Complete any row that is missing fields before outlining it
Create or hold each invoice yourself
systemBehavior: Reads an export. It does not connect to a live accounting system.
Applies skip rules before drafting an outline
Does not add tax or terms that are not in the export
Does not create, send, or collect an invoice
risks: A stale export can hide work that was invoiced after the file was saved
Missing hours or rates must be completed by a person before billing
Creating and sending the invoice remains a human step
